mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, warehouse_id, position_id, quantity) VALUES (#{productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{positionId}, #{quantity})

INSERT INTO inventory_log (product_id, warehouse_id, position_id, type, amount, remark, operator_id, create_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{positionId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, position_id AS positionId, quantity, update_time AS updateTime FROM inventory WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY product_id, position_id

SELECT id, product_id AS productId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, position_id AS positionId, quantity, update_time AS updateTime FROM inventory WHERE position_id = #{positionId} AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY product_id
